## Native question countdown and activity reset

- Patch 0027 exposes the effective native ask-user-question deadline and timeout action to ACP clients. Disabled timers omit countdown metadata.
- Patch 0028 advertises configured activity-reset support and acknowledges a reset only after the native timer processes it. The acknowledgement carries the new deadline; unsupported, disabled, unknown and closed questions return null. Existing activity notifications remain compatible.
- Compatible CodexHost question cards can show the countdown and synchronize it after trusted user interaction. Native timeout configuration and recommended-option selection remain authoritative; clients do not fabricate a user answer.

These additions extend grokgod's patch 0011. They are not stock-Grok guarantees. Source integration: https://github.com/karlorz/grokgod/pull/15. CodexHost integration: https://github.com/karlorz/codex-host/pull/12.
